quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Disciplined off-price retail flywheel operating Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS (~2,377 stores) sharing opportunistic closeout scale with budget-conscious US consumers. Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap (reported GAAP ROIC of 83.32% reflects capital-light lease structure with zero goodwill; ~20-23% lease-adjusted ROIC). FY25 peak Owner EPS of $6.61 represents an all-time record on record sales of $22.75B with 90.56% 5Y FCF conversion. Fortress balance sheet with $4.59B cash against $1.02B LT debt ($3.58B net cash ex-leases) and zero net interest expense. 5-10Y through-the-cycle EPS growth of 7.5% is driven by comp store customer traffic (2.0%), average unit retail pricing (1.5%), new store openings toward ~3,600 target (3.0%), wage and tariff friction (-0.5%), and programmatic share buybacks (1.5% via new $2.55B authorization). Fundamental 3-Pillar PAR Multiple of 25.70x establishes a PAR Value of $169.92. At current share price of $231.09 (34.95x Peak OE), ROST trades at the extreme upper band of historical valuation (exceeding its 5Y cycle high of 34.53x), standing 36.0% Above PAR. Pull-to-PAR multiple mean reversion compresses 5Y expected IRR to 1.80% despite exceptional business franchise quality.
